payload.title: Use Prospectus for waitlist signups; remove Babulus's local waitlist backend
payload.description:
Waitlist, CRM and marketing automation now live in Prospectus (prospectus.anth.us, the central Anthus CRM), with Anthus One (1.anth.us) as the customer portal. Babulus becomes a client of Prospectus and submits signups to its intake.

## Plan
- Point `apps/studio-web/components/marketing/waitlist-form.tsx` at Prospectus's waitlist intake endpoint (site `babulus`, form `babulus-waitlist-v1`). Direct browser call vs thin proxy route will be decided once the Prospectus contract lands (the Prospectus PR is being opened now in AnthusAI/Prospectus).
- Delete the 9 marketing/waitlist models in `apps/studio-web/amplify/data/resource.ts`: MarketingLead, MarketingProgram, MarketingProgramStep, MarketingEnrollment, MarketingEnrollmentEvent, MarketingProgramRule, MarketingProgramTrigger, MarketingInteraction, WaitlistSignup.
- Delete (or slim to a proxy) `apps/studio-web/app/api/waitlist/route.ts`.
- Delete `services/marketing-runtime/`, `apps/studio-web/scripts/list-waitlist.ts` and its npm script, `features/marketing_automation.feature`, `features/marketing_admin_ui.feature`, `features/steps/marketing.steps.ts`.
- Rewrite `docs/marketing-automation.md` and the "Waitlist signups (monitoring)" section of `AGENTS.md`. Update privacy/terms wording about where signup data is stored.

## Notes
- Old signups are treated as lost: the legacy backend stack and its tables no longer exist, so there is no import.
- Cannot go live until the babul.us deploy is unblocked: see 84493f (move Babulus to dedicated account and cut over babul.us).
- Supersedes the closed marketing issues b2f481 (Publicity machine epic and its children), 96272c and 4de6ce.
